column1: # TLA code-range audit (TLA2b; traps 26, 40, 41): vendor C (vendor/alchemy/games/tla at the pinned commit) that
# tells code from data by a value's numeric range or high bits, or measures code by address differences. In wasm
# a code address is a function-table index (0x10000-0x1ffff). Same format and verdicts as GS1's
# port/tools/code_range_audit.tsv (data, safe, fixed, replaced, unused); stage "audit" of
# `tools/web_build.sh --game tla` fails on a hit with no row. Cites file:line + pattern id only.
